bio: Do you fancy Peruvian-Japanese cuisine? This restaurant on the sixth floor of hotel La Réserve Eden au Lac, on the shores of Lake Zurich, serves interesting and unfussy dishes made from top-notch ingredients. Up here you can dine in a cosy atmosphere beneath the exposed roof beams or out on the fantastic rooftop terrace – the view over the lake and the old town is magnificent! Exclusive wine list....
